name: open-ecdh-p256
description: Baseline issuer ECDH P-256 envelope open at one item content-key coordinate. The recorded blob and test key are taken from verification/fixtures/v1/profiles/dca-profile-period-keys/issuer-admission/seal-ecdh.json; this package isolates the content-key ECDH carrier from that mixed content-key and period-key render. Replay the 65-byte uncompressed ephemeral point, AES-256-GCM ciphertext/tag with twelve implicit zero nonce octets. Derive the raw 32-byte ECDH x-coordinate with the issuer private key, use it directly as the AES key without a KDF, and authenticate expected.bind as UTF-8 additional data. The result is the 16-byte content key. The same blob must fail under a different contentName. This package is one carrier observation, not a complete baseline profile claim.
